name: Sunlit colonies (multicellular niche)
description: Cells can bond into colonies with specialized cells: feeders, movers, photosynthesizers (collect sunlight directly), armor and sensors. Specialists are sterile and share energy with the generalist cells that reproduce, and a specialist left with no bonds goes back to being a generalist. Plants barely grow here, so food is scarce and sunlight is the opportunity: in our tests colonies persist in most worlds and the population is about 40% higher than without bonding. Color the dots by Cell type or Colony size; set the starting bond chance to 0 to see whether colonies evolve on their own (they rarely take off).
